correctness.rationale: The source count.c tests the 174251 canonical binary quadric pencils. Its polar alternating-matrix Pfaffian is quadratic in pencil parameters, so every nonidentically-zero polar-degenerate parameter is defined over F4; accepted pencils with identically zero Pfaffian number zero. The GF4 kernel-basepoint rank test accounts for geometric singularities, not just F2 points. I separately inspected count.c, direct16.c and orbits.c and compiled and executed each: count.c reports 40320 accepted, zero Pfaffian-identically-zero acceptances; direct16.c finds 40656 GF4-clean and excludes 336 additional GF16-singular pencils, yielding the identical set of all 40320 canonical pair lines; orbits.c traverses all four GL4(F2) generators giving eight orbits of sizes 10080,5040,5040,2520,5040,2520,5040,5040. Their union is exactly 40320; rational-point histogram is 5040,10080,10080,10080,5040 for 1..5 points. Geometrically smooth (2,2) complete intersection gives genus one and degree four by adjunction. Enumeration is exhaustive only because the degree-two Pfaffian and generator arguments supply the missing geometric and group steps.
